name: Pistachio Crusted Chicken with Lemon-Dill Carrots & Snap Peas
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Finely chop pistachios and place in a medium bowl. Add spices and stir to combine the coating.
Crack eggs into another medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
Working one by one, dip chicken cutlets into the egg, shake off excess, then dredge in the pistachio coating, pressing to adhere. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until the chicken is golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the carrots and snap peas; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 4 minutes.
Zest lemon into the skillet and add spices; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, 2 minutes more.
Meanwhile, cut lemon into wedges for serving.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates. Squeeze lemon over the chicken and enjoy!
author: Mealime
